title: Lomake
description: Read and fill the personal details of a Finnish form: Kela, the health centre, the YKI registration.

steps.title: Forms everywhere
steps.content_html: Kela, the health centre, the library and the YKI registration ask the same details. Learn the form words once.

steps.title: Name and birth
steps.content_html: <fi>etunimi</fi> first name, <fi>sukunimi</fi> surname, <fi>syntymäaika</fi> date of birth, <fi>kansalaisuus</fi> citizenship, <fi>äidinkieli</fi> mother tongue.

steps.title: Who are you?
steps.instruction: Match the form word with its meaning.

steps.title: Contact details
steps.content_html: <fi>osoite</fi> address, <fi>postinumero</fi> postal code, <fi>puhelinnumero</fi> phone number, <fi>sähköposti</fi> email. Together they are <fi>yhteystiedot</fi>, contact details.

steps.title: Dates
steps.content_html: Finnish dates go day, month, year: <fi>5.11.1991</fi> is 5 November 1991.

steps.title: Born when?
steps.question: The form says: Syntymäaika 5.11.1991. When was the person born?
steps.incorrect_feedback: Finnish dates start with the day: 5 is the day, 11 is the month.

steps.title: First name?
steps.statement: On a Finnish form, sukunimi means your first name.
steps.explanation: Sukunimi is the surname. Your first name is etunimi.

steps.title: Mehmet's form
steps.scenario: Mehmet is a citizen of Turkey. His mother tongue is Turkish. The form asks: Äidinkieli.
steps.correct_feedback: Right: the language, in small letters.
steps.incorrect_feedback: Äidinkieli asks for the language, written in small letters: turkki. Turkki with a capital is the country.

steps.title: Fill it in for yourself
steps.content_html: Write your own etunimi, sukunimi, syntymäaika, osoite and puhelinnumero on paper. You will meet these words in every office.
